description: This file implements a TeamCity reporter for the Ginkgo testing framework, generating and merging test reports using TeamCity service messages.

methods.name: tcEscape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for TeamCity service messages.

methods.name: GenerateTeamcityReport
methods.description: Generates a TeamCity report from a Ginkgo report object and writes it to a specified destination file.

methods.name: MergeAndCleanupTeamcityReports
methods.description: Merges multiple TeamCity report files into one and cleans up the source files.
